blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Practitioners use reinforcement learning methods for language models through training frameworks, so a method that a framework includes is one configuration change away for its users. We measure how often this happens. We trace seven open-source frameworks for RL post-training through their commit histories and link them to 6,939 screened arXiv papers from January 2025 to June 2026. Of 1,598 papers that propose a general RL training method, 37 reached at least one framework. Across five quarterly cohorts of papers, the number included within 180 days stayed between 5 and 7 while the cohorts grew from 72 to 386 papers. Compared with papers from the same quarters, included papers more often trained policies of 30B parameters or more, at 41 against 10 percent, and more often changed a coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss, at 29 against 9 percent. Both gaps hold without papers from the companies that maintain the frameworks, while code release was equally common in both groups. The frameworks' issues and pull requests show that few methods are turned away in public. More than nine in ten of the general methods no framework included have no thread there that cites or names them, and many proposals that do appear stay open without a reply. Two further records, the frameworks' issues and the technical reports of 13 large open-weight models, show that users rarely report training failures in public and that the reports state 8 of the 13 widely included methods. We release the data as a tracker that links training failures to framework implementations and lists each framework's contribution rules and earlier proposals.
blocks.zh: 从业人员通过培训框架为语言模型使用强化学习方法,因此,一个框架包括的一种方法是用户的一种配置变化。 我们测量了这种情况的发生频率。 我们通过他们的承诺历史,追踪七个RL培训后开放源码框架,并将其与2025年1月至2026年6月6 939份经过筛选的ArXiv文件联系起来。 在1 598份提出一般远程培训培训方法的论文中,37份至少达到了一个框架。 在五个季度的论文组中,180天之内的论文组数量保持在5至7天之间,而论文组数量从72份增至386份。 与来自同一地区的论文相比,论文更经常地包括经过培训的30B参数或以上的政策,41%对10%,更经常地改变现有损失的系数、夹子、面具或重量,29%对9%。 这两个漏洞都没有维护框架的公司的文件,而代码发布在两个集团中同样常见。 框架的问题和拉动请求表明,很少方法被公开拒绝。 在十种一般方法中,有九种以上没有包含任何框架的线条可以引用或命名这些方法,而且许多确实没有答复的建议似乎不公开。 还有两项记录,即框架问题和13个大型开放重量模型的技术报告显示,用户很少公开报告培训失败,而且报告还说明了13个模型中的8个方法。 我们公布数据,作为追踪器,将培训失败与框架执行联系起来,并列出每个框架的贡献规则和先前的提议。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: GSPO [ 88 ] reached TRL 3 days after its first arXiv version, and verl, OpenRLHF, ROLL and slime followed within a week. All seven frameworks in this study include it today. In the same month, 43 other papers proposed a general RL training method for language models, and only 2 of them reached any of the seven frameworks.
blocks.zh: 普惠制O[88]在第一个arXiv版本3天后达到TRL,verl,OpenRLHF,ROLL和粘液在一周内紧随其后. 这项研究的所有七个框架都包含在今天。 同月,其他43篇论文提出了语言模型的一般RL培训方法,其中只有2篇达到了7个框架中的任何一篇.

blocks.en: Research on RL post-training has grown fast: in each month of the first half of 2026, at least 144 papers in our pool proposed an RL training method. Practitioners meet these methods through the frameworks they train with, and a framework decides whether a method is one configuration change away or a separate project. Publishing a method, releasing its code and having a framework include it are three separate outcomes, and the last one has not been measured.
blocks.zh: 对RL后训练的研究发展很快:2026年上半年的每个月,我们人才库里至少有144篇论文提出了RL训练方法. 从业人员通过他们所培训的框架满足这些方法,一个框架决定一种方法是改变一个配置还是改变一个单独的项目。 发布一种方法,释出其代码并有一个框架包括它,是三种不同的结果,最后一种没有被衡量.

blocks.en: We measure framework inclusion. A method counts as included when its implementation reaches the main branch of a tracked framework, and we record the tier of each inclusion: a default, a selectable algorithm, a switch, experimental code or an example recipe. Inclusion describes the code that frameworks ship, and Section 11 sets out its limits.
blocks.zh: 我们衡量框架的包容性。 一种方法在它的执行到达跟踪框架的主要分支时算在内,我们记录每个包含的层次:默认,可选择的算法,开关,实验代码或示例食谱. 包容描述了框架船的代码,第11节规定了其界限。

blocks.en: Inclusion is rare: only 37 of 1,598 papers that propose a general method reached one of seven frameworks (2.3 percent). The included methods differ from the rest in two ways (Section 6 ). Their papers more often trained policies of 30B parameters or more, at 41 against 10 percent, and more often changed a coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss, at 29 against 9 percent. Code release was equally common, at 44 percent of included papers and 44 percent of others. The two gaps persist without model reports, within papers that have an industry author, and without papers from the companies that maintain the frameworks. They remain associations, and Section 6 sets out their limits.
blocks.zh: 包容很少:1 598份提出一般方法的论文中只有37份达到7个框架之一(2.3%)。 所采用的方法与其他方法有两种不同(第6节)。 他们的论文更经常地训练出30B参数或以上的政策,以41比10%,更经常地改变现有损失的系数、夹子、面具或重量,以29%对9%。 密码发布同样常见,包括44%的论文和44%的其他论文。 这两个差距继续存在,没有示范报告,没有行业作者的论文,没有维护框架的公司的文件。 它们仍然是协会,第6节规定了其限度。

blocks.en: The intake did not keep pace with the supply. Across five quarterly cohorts, the number of general methods a framework included within 180 days stayed between 5 and 7, while the cohorts grew from 72 to 386 papers, a 5.4-fold rise (Figure 1 b). Counted by the date of the landing instead, first landings of general methods rose from 3 a quarter at the start of 2025 to 10 at its end. The frameworks took in more methods as the supply grew, but a shrinking share of each cohort.
blocks.zh: 摄入量跟不上供应量. 在五个季度组群中,180天之内纳入的框架的一般方法数目保持在5至7天之间,组群从72份增至386份,增长了5.4倍(图1b)。 按登陆日期计算,一般方法的首次登陆从2025年初的3个季度上升到其末的10个. 随着供应的增长,这些框架采用了更多方法,但每组人的比例都在下降。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Inclusion, supply against intake, and the public record of the rest. Unit: paper. (a) Papers from January 2025 to June 2026: the screened pool, papers that propose an RL training method, general methods, and general methods by the strongest inclusion they reached, on a log scale. (b) General methods by the quarter of their first arXiv version in grey, and those a framework included within 180 days of that version in blue, for the quarters with 180 days of exposure before the snapshot for every paper, on a log scale. (c) General methods that no framework included, grouped by the threads in the seven frameworks that link them, give their identifier or quote their title, on a log scale. These groups are categories and not stages.
blocks.zh: 图1:包容、供应与摄入量,以及其余部分的公开记录。 单元:文件。 (a) 2025年1月至2026年6月的文件:经过筛选的人才库、提出远程培训方法、一般方法和一般方法的论文,用最强的输入方式,按日志尺度计算。 (b) 按日志比例,按每份文件在快照前180天暴露的季度,按灰色第一arXiv版本的季度采用一般方法,并按蓝色版本的180天内纳入框架。 (c) 按日志比例排列,按七个框架中链接、提供标识符或引用其标题的线条分类,没有列入任何框架的一般方法。 这些群体是类别而不是阶段。

blocks.en: Few of the other methods were turned away in public. We collected the issues, pull requests and discussions of all seven frameworks and searched them for every general method in the pool. Maintainers declined or redirected proposals for only 12 of the 1,561 general methods that no framework included. Most never came up in a framework’s issues or pull requests at all: 96 percent have no thread that cites them (Figure 1 c), and a search by method name lowers this only to 95 percent. Many proposals that do appear stay open without a reply. Merged pull requests also drew concerns, mostly about design and tests, and their authors often revised the code in response. Concerns about demand and maintenance burden appear mostly in proposals that were not merged, and most of those come from one framework (Section 7 ).
blocks.zh: 其他方法很少被公开拒绝。 我们收集了问题,收集了所有七个框架的要求和讨论,并搜索了这些框架的每一个一般方法。 在1 561项一般方法中,没有任何框架,维护者只拒绝了其中12项提案或重新定向了提案。 大部分都从未出现在一个框架的问题或拉动请求中:96%没有线程引用(图1c),按方法命名的搜索将这个比例降到95%。 似乎没有答复的许多建议继续开放。 合并的拉动请求也引起了人们的担忧,主要是对设计和测试的担忧,其作者经常修改代码以回应. 对需求和维持负担的关切大多出现在没有合并的提案中,其中大多数来自一个框架(第7节)。

blocks.en: Two further records place inclusion next to users and to large training runs. In the frameworks’ issues and discussions, 48 of the 7,075 threads opened since January 2025 report a training failure, and the failures they name are distributed differently from those that paper abstracts address (Section 8 ). Technical reports of 13 open-weight models with 100B parameters or more state 8 of the 13 widely included methods, describe variants of others under their own names, and are the source of 2 (Section 9 ).
blocks.zh: 另有两项记录将包容性置于用户旁边,并置于大型培训运行之后。 在框架问题和讨论中,自2025年1月以来开放的7 075条线中有48条报告培训失败,它们所列举的失败与论文摘要地址的失败不同(第8节)。 13个具有100B参数或以上的开放重量模型的技术报告在13个被广泛包含的方法中的状态8,以自己的名字描述其他模型的变体,是2的来源(第9节).

blocks.en: We release the data and code as a tracker. Its index links training failures, such as entropy collapse or a mismatch between rollout and training probabilities, to the implementations and settings in each framework. A second page gives each framework’s contribution rules, the concerns its reviewers raised and the outcome of earlier proposals, as a starting point for authors who want a framework to include their method.
blocks.zh: 我们发布数据和代码 作为追踪器。 其指数将培训失败,如肽崩溃或推出和培训概率不匹配,与每个框架中的执行和设置联系起来。 第二页列出每个框架的贡献规则、其审查者提出的关切以及先前建议的结果,作为希望框架包括方法的作者的出发点。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Studies of industry and academia in AI mostly work at the level of papers and topics. They track the growing share of industry in AI research [ 2 ] and the association between code availability and citation counts [ 90 ] . Forks of the repositories that accompany ML papers rarely change the code, and fewer send changes back [ 5 ] . These measures capture attention among researchers but do not observe whether a method reaches the code that trains models.
blocks.zh: 大赦国际的行业和学术界研究大多在论文和专题一级进行。 他们追踪了工业在AI研究中越来越大的份额[2],以及代码可用性和引用数之间的联系[90]. 伴随ML文件的寄存器叉很少改变代码,更少寄回更改[5]. 这些措施吸引了研究人员的注意力,但没有观察到一种方法是否达到了训练模型的代码.

blocks.en: A second line asks whether reported gains hold up. Re-evaluations in recommendation [ 12 ] and metric learning [ 50 ] found that many improvements vanished under careful comparison, and broader critiques point to benchmark selection [ 15 ] and scholarship practice [ 38 ] . Implementation details matter as much in policy-gradient methods: code-level choices explain much of the reported gap between PPO and TRPO [ 17 ] , and an implementation guide lists 37 such details for PPO alone [ 29 ] . For RL with language models, controlled studies compare tricks under one implementation [ 44 ] and test methods at large compute [ 31 ] . These studies ask whether a method works. We ask whether frameworks include it, and we read the answer from their code.
blocks.zh: 第二行询问报告的收益是否维持。 重新评价建议[12]和衡量学习[50]发现,在仔细比较下,许多改进已不复存在,更广泛的批评指出,选择基准[15]和奖学金做法[38]。 执行细节在政策分级方法中同样重要:编码级选择解释了所报告的PPO和TRPO之间大部分差距[17],一份执行指南列出了仅PPO就存在的37个此类细节[29]. 对于语言模型的RL,受控研究在一个执行[44]下比较诡计,一般计算测试方法[31]. 这些研究询问一种方法是否有效. 我们问,框架是否包括它,我们从它们的代码中读到了答案。

blocks.en: A third line studies the decisions of open-source projects on outside contributions. Only a few factors drive the decision to merge a pull request, and few rejections are technical [ 23 ] . Project managers weigh technical signals together with their social ties to the submitter [ 72 ] , and integrators report trouble keeping quality high and ranking the contributions they receive [ 24 ] . Reviewers also look at signals beyond the code [ 19 ] , and ties across an ecosystem shift acceptance [ 46 ] . These studies explain decisions about code contributions in general. We follow a narrower object: a method from a paper, traced from its evidence to its implementation in a training framework and to the public record of each proposal.
blocks.zh: 第三行研究开放源码项目关于外部捐款的决定。 只有少数因素驱动着合并拉力请求的决定,很少有拒绝是技术性的[23]. 项目经理将技术信号与他们与提交者的社会联系放在一起权衡,综合人员报告难以保持高质量,并排名他们收到的捐款[24]。 审查者还审视了超出代码的信号[19],以及生态系统转移接受度之间的关联[46]。 这些研究一般地解释了关于代码贡献的决定. 我们遵循一个较狭义的目标:从一份文件中找到一种方法,从文件的证据到在培训框架内执行文件以及每项提案的公开记录。

blocks.en: 3 Measuring inclusion
blocks.zh: 3个 衡量包容性

blocks.en: We study verl [ 64 ] with its recipe repository, TRL [ 74 ] , OpenRLHF [ 27 ] , NeMo-RL [ 51 ] , ROLL [ 76 ] , slime [ 92 ] and AReaL [ 20 ] . All seven meet four criteria: they are built for RL post-training of language models, run their own training loop with several selectable RL algorithms, are developed in public, and have at least 2,000 GitHub stars. Four other frameworks meet the same criteria: open-instruct, SkyRL, prime-rl and RLinf (Table 10 ). At their latest commits they implement 2 general methods that none of the seven include, so adding them would raise the inclusion rate from 2.3 to 2.4 percent. The snapshots of six frameworks date from 13 to 17 October 2026. OpenRLHF had no main-branch commit after 17 September 2026, so its snapshot is older (Table 10 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用它的食谱存储器研究verl [64],TRL [74],OpenRLHF [27],NeMo-RL [51],ROLL [76],粘液 [92]和AReaL [20]. 所有7个都符合4个标准:它们都是为语言模型的RL后训练而建造的,用几种可选的RL算法运行自己的训练循环,在公共场合开发,至少有2000颗GitHub星. 其他四个框架符合同样的标准:开放式指令、SkyRL、prim-rl和RLinf(表10)。 最迟,它们承诺实施7个方法中没有一个包括的2个一般方法,因此,加上这些方法,将把包容率从2.3%提高到2.4%。 6个框架的简介日期为2026年10月13日至17日。 OpenRLHF在2026年9月17日之后没有主分支承诺,因此它的快照更老(表10.

blocks.en: Each framework exposes its RL algorithms in a few places. verl registers advantage estimators and policy losses by name, while TRL selects GRPO losses through a loss-type field and keeps newer trainers in an experimental folder. AReaL ships one example configuration per algorithm, and the other frameworks use command-line choices and configuration switches. We list these places for each framework, parse them at every commit on the main branch, and check the result against each framework’s algorithm documentation at the snapshot.
blocks.zh: 每个框架会在几个地方暴露其RL算法. verl按名称记录优势估计值和政策损失,而TRL通过损失类型字段选择GRPO损失,并将较新的教练员保存在实验文件夹中. AReaL每算法传输一个实例配置,其他框架使用命令行选择和配置开关. 我们列出每个框架的这些位置,在主分支的每个承诺中分析这些位置,并在快照时对照每个框架的算法文件检查结果。

blocks.en: We record the tier of each inclusion. A default is on in a run that keeps every setting. A conditional default is on by default once a related feature is enabled, such as generation with vLLM. A core option is a selectable algorithm in the main code path, and a switch modifies the main algorithm. Experimental code and example recipes sit outside the main path.
blocks.zh: 我们记录每份清单的级别。 默认值正在运行, 以保持每个设置 。 一旦启用了相关功能,例如具有vLLM的生成,则默认存在有条件的默认. 核心选项是主代码路径中可选择的算法,切换器会修改主算法. 实验代码和实例食谱坐落在主路径之外.

blocks.en: Frameworks name the same method differently: clip-higher [ 84 ] appears as clip_ratio_high in verl, epsilon_high in TRL, eps_clip_low_high in OpenRLHF and eps-clip-high in slime. We map every option name to one entry in a catalog of 65 methods and check each source against its arXiv record. The parser reports every option it detects without a mapping, and the build fails until the option is mapped. An event is the addition or removal of an option, or a change of its default, on a main branch, and the history of the seven frameworks yields 426 events. Implementations outside the parsed places are the target of the documentation check and of the citation audit below.
blocks.zh: 框架命名方法不同:夹片高[84]在verl中作为夹片_ratio_高出现,epsilon_高在TRL,eps_clip_low_高在OpenRLHF中出现,eps-clip-高在粘液中出现. 我们将每个选项名称映射到一个包含65个方法的目录中的条目,并对照其arXiv记录检查每个来源. 解析器报告它检测到的没有映射的每个选项, 构建失败, 直到该选项被映射 。 一个事件是在一个主要分支上添加或删除一个选项,或更改其默认,七个框架的历史产生426个事件. 分析地点以外的执行是以下文件检查和引用审计的目标。

blocks.en: Parsing misses an implementation that sits under a name the catalog does not map, in a place we do not parse, or in a change to existing code. We therefore searched the full main-branch history of each framework for the arXiv identifiers of pool papers and kept every file that cites one. Framework files cite 51 general methods, including all 28 that parsing had found. For 9 of the other 23, a citation sits next to an implementation, and we added them to the catalog. Two of them add no option: a fix to the KL gradient in NeMo-RL and the trajectory-level agent pipeline of ROLL. We record such implementations from their commits, so the implementation stays the test of inclusion. The remaining papers appear in lists of projects built on a framework, in reference lists of technical reports, or as background (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 解析错过了一个执行,它坐落在目录不映射的名称下,在一个我们不解析的地方,或者在对现有代码的修改中。 因此,我们搜索了每个框架的整个主干部门历史,以了解游泳池文件的arXiv标识,并保留了引用一个文件的每个文件。 框架文件引用了51种一般方法,包括分析发现的所有28种方法。 对于另外23个中的9个,一个引用坐在一个执行的旁边,我们把它们添加到目录中. 其中两个没有增加选项:NeMo-RL中KL梯度的固定和ROLL的轨迹级代理管道. 我们从他们的承诺中记录这种执行,因此,执行仍然是包容性的考验。 其余文件载于基于框架的项目清单、技术报告参考清单或背景(附录E)。

blocks.en: A date is the commit date on the main branch, an approximation of the day a change became available there. An option first seen in a repository’s root commit, in a bulk code release, or in a commit that renamed an existing option has an unknown start, so we treat such a date as an upper bound. A landing is the first commit that brings a method into one framework, and the first landing of a method is its earliest landing in any framework. A later exact date from another framework never replaces an earlier upper bound. Lags run from the first arXiv version of the source, or from the post date for blog sources.
blocks.zh: 日期是主分支的承诺日期,是该分支出现变化之日的近似日期。 一个选项首先出现在寄存器的根部承诺中,在批量代码释放中,或者在重新命名为现有选项的承诺中,有一个未知的开始,所以我们将这样的日期视为上限. 着陆是第一个将方法带入一个框架的承诺,一个方法的第一次着陆是它在任何框架中最早的着陆. 从另一个框架到另一个框架的后一个具体日期,永远不会取代早先的上限。 Lags运行于源头的第一个arXiv版本,或从博客来源的邮箱日期.

blocks.en: For each landing we compare the git author of the introducing commit with the author list of the source. The comparison has four outcomes: a paper author, a named person outside the list, a handle we cannot resolve, and a source without an author list. When the commit names a pull request, we also record who opened it, who merged it and who reviewed it. We call a person a prior merger of a framework once they have merged a pull request there, comparing UTC timestamps with the event in question. Prior mergers stand in for maintainers, but the proxy misses reviewers without merge rights and people before their first merge, and it keeps people who have since left. We also match the affiliations on each paper’s first page against the company that maintains each framework, such as ByteDance for verl and NVIDIA for NeMo-RL. OpenRLHF has no maintaining company.
blocks.zh: 每次着陆时,我们都会将介绍行为的作者与来源的作者清单进行比较。 比较有四个结果:一个纸质作者,一个名单之外的名字,一个我们无法解决的手柄,一个没有作者名单的来源. 当承诺名称 一个拉请求,我们也记录 谁打开,谁合并,谁审查。 我们称一个人是一个框架的前合并,一旦他们把一个拉动请求合并到那里,就可以将UTC的时间戳与相关的事件进行比较. 先前的合并代表维护者,但代理者错过了审查者没有合并的权利,以及第一次合并之前的人,它保留了后来离开的人. 我们还将每份文件第一页的隶属关系与维持每个框架的公司相匹配,例如,ByteDance for verl和NVIDIA for NeMo-RL。 OpenRLHF没有维持公司。

blocks.en: 4 Measuring the supply of methods
blocks.zh: 页:1 衡量方法的供应情况

blocks.en: Keyword search through the arXiv API misses papers that typeset method names in LaTeX. The DAPO abstract, for example, writes its name through bold initials. We therefore harvest the complete computer science metadata through the arXiv OAI-PMH interface and keep the 139,135 records in cs.LG, cs.CL or cs.AI with identifiers from 2501 to 2606. A paper enters the pool when its title or abstract mentions language models and reinforcement learning, including the abbreviations RL and RFT. The pool holds 6,939 papers and contains 45 of the 46 catalog sources from this window. This check covers included sources only, so the pool is a screened set and not a complete census of RL papers.
blocks.zh: 通过 arXiv API 键字搜索错过了在 LaTeX 中输入方法名称的纸张 。 例如,DAPO抽象通过粗体首字母来写它的名字. 因此,我们通过ARXIV审调处-PMH接口收集完整的计算机科学元数据,并将139 135个记录保存在cs.LG、cs.CL或cs中。 具有2501年至2606年识别特征的AI. 一篇论文在标题或抽象提及语言模型和强化学习时进入了池中,包括缩写RL和RFT. 游泳池持有6,939份论文,并包含来自这个窗口的46个目录来源中的45个. 这种检查只包括来源,所以池子是经过筛选的一组,而不是对RL文件的完整人口普查.

blocks.en: Each paper receives one of seven labels from its title and abstract under fixed rules (Appendix A ). The label of interest marks a new or modified training-time RL component. We call such a method general when the component is the paper’s main contribution and is presented for RL with language models at large. We call it embedded when it serves a paper about one task, domain or application. The denominator is the set of general methods.
blocks.zh: 每张纸都从标题中获得一个标签,并在固定规则(Appendix A.)下获得抽象的7个标签之一. 兴趣标签标志着一个新的或修改后的训练时间RL组件. 我们称这种方法为通用方法,如果该部分是论文的主要贡献,并且是用一般语言模型为RL提出的。 我们称之为嵌入式,当它服务于关于一个任务,域或应用的论文. 分母是一套一般方法.

blocks.en: Three checks address recognition, stability and the general rule. For recognition, the included sources were mixed into the first batches without marking, and 29 of the 30 sources not used as examples in the labelling rules were labelled as methods. The miss is a technical report that describes its method only in the body. For stability, 140 papers were labelled twice in separate batches and kept the same primary label 129 times. For the general rule, a stratified sample of 200 papers was reviewed manually. Review and labels agree on 188 of them for the split between general methods and all other papers, and weighting by the three label strata puts the number of general methods at about 1,590 (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 三项检查涉及识别、稳定和一般规则。 为了确认这一点,包括的来源被混入第一批没有标记的来源,标签规则中未用作例子的30个来源中有29个被标为方法。 错失是一份技术报告,它只描述了它在体内的方法. 为稳定起见,140份论文被分批两次贴上标签,并保留了129次相同的主标签。 就一般规则而言,对200份分级的论文进行了人工审查。 审查和标签商定其中188项,涉及一般方法与所有其他文件的分割,由三个标签层加权得出一般方法的数目约为1,590(附录B)。

blocks.en: Technical reports for new models often describe their RL changes only in the body, so we read 70 randomly drawn reports in full. The sample holds 30 reports labelled as methods and 40 labelled otherwise, and it leaves out reports with included methods. A transferable RL component appears in the body of 25 reports of the first group and 6 of the second. The general rule asks for more than a transferable component, so these counts bound the effect of abstract-only labels from above. Counting every report with such a component as a general method would raise the denominator by at most about 13 percent and lower the inclusion rate from 2.3 to 2.1 percent.
blocks.zh: 新模型的技术报告常常只描述它们的RL变化在体内,所以我们完全阅读了70个随机抽取的报告. 样本中有30份报告被贴上方法标签,40份报告被贴上其他方法标签,其中不包括包含方法的报告。 第一组的25份报告和第二组的6份报告正文载有可转让的参考清单部分。 一般规则要求的不只是可转让组件,因此这些计数从上面约束了抽象的标签的效果. 将每份包含这样内容的报告作为一般方法计算,最多可提高13%左右,并将纳入率从2.3%降至2.1%。

blocks.en: 5 Inclusion rate
blocks.zh: 5 包容率

blocks.en: Few general methods reach a framework. Figure 1 a follows the pool from all RL papers to framework defaults: 37 of 1,598 general methods reached at least one framework, a rate of 2.3 percent. Three or more frameworks include 7 of them today, and 1 is an unconditional default.
blocks.zh: 基本方法很少达到框架。 图1a列出了从所有RL文件到框架默认的集合:在1 598个一般方法中,37个方法至少达到一个框架,比率为2.3%。 3个或更多框架包括今天的7个框架,1个框架是无条件的默认。

blocks.en: Many methods were brought in by people outside the author list. For 18 included papers, at least one landing came from a named commit author outside the paper’s author list. Another 12 reached frameworks only through commits by their authors, and the remaining 7 only through unresolved handles or sources without an author list.
blocks.zh: 许多方法都是作者名单以外的人提出的。 包括18份论文,至少有一份来自论文作者名单之外的一个有名的作者。 另有12个只通过作者的承诺才达到框架,其余7个仅通过未解决的手柄或来源,没有作者名单。

blocks.en: Another 8 included papers fall outside the general rule from their abstracts. Most are model reports or system papers with an included component in the body (Appendix D ). Adding them gives 45 included papers out of 1,606, with 9 in three or more frameworks.
blocks.zh: 还有8份论文不属于其摘要的一般规则范围。 多数报告是示范报告或系统文件,其中包含一个组成部分(附录D)。 在1 606份论文中,增加45份,3份或更多。

blocks.en: Exposure time matters: papers from 2025 had at least nine months before the snapshot, and 31 of 769 reached a framework. Papers from the first half of 2026 had less time, and 6 of 829 did. With a common window, 30 of the 1,155 general methods with at least 180 days of exposure were included within 180 days. Counted by the quarter of the landing instead, first landings of general methods rose from 3 in the first quarter of 2025 to 10 in the fourth, and 9 landed in the first quarter of 2026. The intake grew while the share of each cohort included within 180 days fell from 6.9 to 1.3 percent.
blocks.zh: 曝光时间问题:2025年的论文至少在快照前9个月,769篇中的31篇达到框架. 2026年上半年的论文时间较少,829年中有6篇. 有了共同的窗口,至少有180天接触的1,155个一般方法中有30个在180天内包括在内。 以登陆季度为例,通用方法的首次登陆从2025年第一季度的3次升至第四季度的10次,2026年第一季度的9次登陆. 摄入量增加,180天内每组人的比例从6.9%下降到1.3%。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Time from first public version to a main branch. Unit: catalog method with a dated source from 2025 or later that reached two or more frameworks. Figure 5 in the appendix shows every method. Each mark is one landing. Hollow dots mark commits by a paper author. Crosses mark landings in a bulk release or a renaming commit, and their dates are upper bounds. Landings within a few days of each other are spread vertically within their row. The larger mark with a number counts landings too close to draw apart: five frameworks took in GSPO between 3 and 7 days after its first version.
blocks.zh: 图2:从第一个公开版本到一个主要分支的时间. 单位:有2025年或以后日期来源的目录方法,达到两个或两个以上的框架。 附录中的图5显示了各种方法。 每个标记是一次着陆。 空白点标记由纸作者承担. 十字架在批量释放或重命名承诺中标记着陆,其日期为上界. 相距数日之内的着陆在其行内垂直分布. 数量较大的标记计算着陆量太近,无法分解:五个框架在第一个版本之后3至7天内进入了普惠制。

blocks.en: Inclusion is fast when it happens. Among the 54 catalog methods with a source from 2025 or later, 49 have an exact first landing, and their median time from the first arXiv version to a main branch is 30 days (Figure 2 ). Another 4 have only an upper bound, and 1 blog source is dated only by month. Counted once per source paper, the median is 30.5 days over 42 papers, and in 5 cases the commit predates the arXiv version. These medians describe included methods only. Among methods in three or more frameworks, CISPO [ 49 ] is the slowest: it reached its first framework at most 135 days after its source, and TRL added it later in a commit named after a large comparison study [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 发生时包容速度很快. 在来源于2025年或以后的54个目录方法中,49个有精确的首次着陆,它们从第一个arXiv版本到主分支的中位时间为30天(图2 ). 另外4个只有上限, 每份原始文件计算一次,中间值为42份文件的30.5天,在5份文件中,承诺比arXiv版本早。 这些中位数只描述方法。 在三个或三个以上框架中的方法中,CISPO[49]是最慢的:它在其来源后最多135天就达到了第一个框架,TRL后来将其添加到一项以一项大比较研究命名的承诺中[31].

blocks.en: Authorship changes with breadth. Among the 38 recent methods found in exactly one framework, 13 first landed through a commit by a paper author, most of them as example recipes. Methods in three or more frameworks have 70 landings, and 40 of these came from named people outside the author list. Paper authors made 6, unresolved handles 18, and the remaining 6 belong to blog sources without an author list.
blocks.zh: 作者随宽度变化. 最近在一个框架内发现的38种方法中,有13种是首先通过论文作者的一次承诺落地的,其中大多数是作为实例的食谱。 三个或三个以上框架的方法有70次着陆,其中40次来自作者名单之外的名字。 本文作者提出了6个未解决的手柄18个,其余6个属于博客来源,没有作者名单.

blocks.en: Defaults are rare. TRL turned on token-level loss aggregation in August 2025 and sets the KL coefficient to zero by default. It also enables truncated importance sampling by default once generation with vLLM is switched on, and applies the importance-weighted KL correction of DeepSeek-V3.2 [ 14 ] once the KL coefficient is non-zero. NeMo-RL applies the corrected KL gradient of Tang and Munos [69] whenever its KL penalty is non-zero (Section 7 ). Table 1 lists the recent methods included in three or more frameworks.
blocks.zh: 默认是罕见的。 TRL在2025年8月开启了象征级损失汇总,默认将KL系数设定为零. 它还允许在使用 vLLM 启动生成时默认使用短重采样,并在 KL 系数为非0 时应用 Depseek-V3.2 [14] 的重加权 KL 校正. NeMo-RL在KL处罚为非零时,适用唐和穆诺斯经改正的KL梯度[69](第7节)。 表1列出了三个或三个以上框架中的最新方法。

blocks.en: Table 1: Recent methods included in three or more frameworks. Unit: catalog method. Days run from the first public version of the source to the first landing on a main branch. A ≤ \leq sign marks an upper bound, and negative values mean the commit predates the arXiv version. Of these, truncated importance sampling (TIS) is a conditional default in TRL and token-level loss aggregation is a default in TRL.
blocks.zh: 表1:列入三个或更多框架的近期方法。 单位:目录方法. 天数从源头的第一个公开版本到主分支的首次登陆. \\ leq 标志标记上方的界限, 负值表示承诺早于 arXiv 版本 。 其中,短重采样(TIS)在TRL中是有条件的默认,符号级损失汇总在TRL中是默认.

blocks.en: 6 Features of included methods
blocks.zh: 6 包括方法的特点

blocks.en: Figure 3 compares the 31 included general methods from 2025 with 150 general methods from the same year that no framework included. The controls were drawn at random within each quarter, and fields were coded from the first arXiv version of each paper without access to inclusion status (Appendix C ). The citation audit found 8 of the included papers later, and a second reader recoded these papers blind. The comparison uses the blind codes, and Table 7 gives the gaps without them. The comparison is descriptive, because scale, resources, team composition and breadth of experiments can vary together.
blocks.zh: 图3比较了2025年31个包括一般方法的同年150个没有框架的一般方法。 每个季度内随机抽取控制,并且从每份文件的第一个arXiv版本编码字段,没有加入状态(附录C. 引用审计后发现8篇包含的论文,第二位读者对这些论文重新编码为盲文. 比较采用盲码,表7给出没有盲码的差距. 这种比较是描述性的,因为规模,资源,团队组成和实验的广度可以一起变化.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Coded fields, included against non-included general methods from 2025. Unit: paper. Each row compares the share among included papers with the share among papers from the same quarters that no framework included. The right columns give the counts, included first. Two shares within three points of each other are drawn one above the other. Papers that do not report a property are left out of that row.
blocks.zh: 图3:从2025年起对照非包含的一般方法列入的编码字段。 单位:纸张. 每行都比较所包括文件与没有框架的同一批文件的比例。 右栏给出计数,包括第一. 三分之内两股各取一上. 不报告财产的文件就被排除在外。

blocks.en: The figure shows every coded field. We single out two of them because they have the largest ratio between the groups among the fields that at least five papers show in each group. Mixture-of-experts policies differ by a larger ratio, but they appear in only 3 included papers and 1 other.
blocks.zh: 该图显示每个编码字段. 我们挑出其中两个,因为它们在每组至少有五篇论文显示的领域中各组的比例最大。 专家混合政策因比例较大而不同,但只出现在3份论文和1份其他文件中。

blocks.en: Scale shows the largest gap. Policies of 30B parameters or more appear in 41 percent of included papers and 10 percent of the others. The gap persists after excluding model reports, at 12 of 29 against 13 of 139, and within papers that have an industry author, at 10 of 25 against 11 of 90. Counting every unreported size against the gap still leaves 12 of 31 against 23 of 150.
blocks.zh: 缩放显示最大差距 。 30B参数或以上的政策出现在41%的列入文件中,10%在其他文件中。 在排除示范报告之后,差距继续存在,29份为12份,139份为13份;在有行业作者的论文中,25份为10份,90份为11份。 计算每个未报告的大小与差距相比,仍然有12个31,23个150。

blocks.en: The form of the change also differs. A coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss was the change in 29 percent of included papers and 9 percent of the others, while a new training stage or model was the change in 26 against 53 percent. The frameworks expose the widely included methods in the same compact form: one or two configuration fields or loss names, such as clip_ratio_high in verl and epsilon_high in TRL for clip-higher (Table 11 ). The compact form describes the method and not the size of its code, because pull requests for coefficient changes were about as large as those for new loss terms (Section 7 ). The number of new hyperparameters is missing for many papers, and under the least favourable treatment of missing values its gap reverses, so we do not interpret it.
blocks.zh: 变化的形式也有所不同。 现有损失中的一个系数、夹子、面具或重量是29%的文件和其他文件的9%的变化,而一个新的培训阶段或模式是26%与53%的变化。 这些框架以相同的紧凑形式揭示了被广泛纳入的方法:一两个配置字段或丢失名称,如shit_ratio_high in verl和epsilon_high in TRL for shit-higher (表11). 紧凑的表格描述了方法,而不是其代码的大小,因为拉动系数变化的请求与新损失条款的请求大致相同(第7节)。 许多论文缺少新的超参数数,在对缺失值最不有利的处理下,其差距逆转,所以我们不加以解释.

blocks.en: The two gaps hold outside the frameworks’ own companies. Included papers come from a company that maintains one of the frameworks more often than others, at 32 against 15 percent, but only 5 were included by that company’s framework. Across all 37 included papers, 11 come from such a company and 6 were included by its own framework, such as DAPO in verl and DLER in NeMo-RL. Inclusion also crosses company lines through the people who commit: all 18 papers with an outside committer had such a landing in a framework outside their own company. Without any such paper in either group, large policies appear in 6 of 19 included papers against 9 of 119 others, and coefficient changes in 6 of 21 against 13 of 128 (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 这两个差距存在于框架本身的公司之外。 包括的文件来自一个公司,它比其他公司更经常地维持其中一个框架,占32%,占15%,但该公司的框架只包括5个。 在所有37份包含的文件中,11份来自这样一个公司,6份来自自己的框架,如Verl中的DAPO和NeMo-RL中的DLER。 包容还跨越公司界限,通过犯罪者:所有18份与外部犯罪者有关的文件都在其公司以外的框架里登船。 如果没有任何这类文件,19个国家中的6个国家就出现了大的政策,包括119个国家中的9个国家,21个国家中的6个国家和128个国家中的13个国家(表7)的系数变化。

blocks.en: Code release was equally common in both groups. The first version links training code in 44 percent of included papers and 44 percent of others, so a public implementation alone does not set the included methods apart. Other fields point the same way as the main gaps with smaller differences. A named training failure motivated 84 percent of included papers and 70 percent of others, and evaluation beyond one domain appears in 55 against 48 percent of them. Industry authors appear on 90 percent of included papers and 64 percent of others, while included papers reported compute less often, at 19 against 29 percent.
blocks.zh: 代码发布在两个组中同样常见. 第一版将44%的论文和44%的其他论文中的培训代码联系起来,因此,仅仅公开执行并不能将包含的方法分开。 其它字段指向与主要差距相同,差异较小. 一项所谓的培训失败促使了84%的论文和其他70%的论文,超出一个领域的评价出现在55%,而其中48%。 工业作者在90%的论文和64%的其他论文中出现,而包括的论文报告的计算次数较少,为19%,29%。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Inclusion by component. Unit: general method, each with one primary component label. Share of general methods in each component that reached at least one framework, with counts. Rows are ordered by the number of general methods, and components with fewer than ten are omitted.
blocks.zh: 图4:按构成部分分列的纳入情况。 单位:一般方法,每个都有一个主元件标签. 每个组成部分中一般方法的比例至少达到一个框架,有计数。 行按一般方法的数量排列,小于10个的组件省略.

blocks.en: Inclusion also differs by component (Figure 4 ). Methods that change clipping or the trust region, off-policy correction, or loss aggregation make up 187 of the general methods, and 10 of these reached a framework, 3 of them three or more. Rollout sampling is the most crowded component. Together with credit assignment it accounts for 554 general methods, 4 inclusions and none in three or more frameworks. This comparison covers framework options only (Section 11 ).
blocks.zh: 包容性也因组成部分而异(图4)。 改变剪报或信任区、政策外更正或损失汇总的方法占一般方法的187个,其中10个达到框架,其中3个或更多。 推出抽样是最拥挤的部分。 连同信贷转让,它包括554个一般方法、4个纳入方法以及3个或3个以上的框架。 这一比较仅涵盖框架备选方案(第11节)。

blocks.en: Most of the widely included methods are motivated by a failure that appears in long or large runs: entropy collapse, length bias, extreme importance ratios, instability in mixture-of-experts models, and the mismatch between rollout and training probabilities (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 大多数广泛采用的方法都是由于长期或大周期出现的失败引起的:肽崩溃、长度偏差、极端重要比率、专家混合模型的不稳定性以及推出和培训概率之间的不匹配(表1)。

blocks.en: 7 Proposals and merges
blocks.zh: 7 提案和合并

blocks.en: Table 2: Methods and proposals by framework. Unit: landing of a catalog method with a source from 2025 or later, and proposals for general methods that no framework included. Methods counts the landings in the framework, and first anywhere counts the methods with their first landing there. Median days run from the source to the landing and leave out upper bounds. A landing pull request counts as opened by a prior merger when its author had merged a pull request in the framework before opening it, and each pull request counts once. Days open run from opening to merge. Proposals are the coded issues and pull requests of Table 9 , and lapsed proposals were closed as inactive or in a stale-issue cleanup. Declined proposals include those redirected elsewhere. ROLL publishes code in bulk releases without pull requests.
blocks.zh: 表2:按框架分列的方法和建议。 单位:从2025年或以后使用源头的编目方法落地,以及不包含框架的一般方法建议. 方法计算框架的着陆量,首先在任何地方计算方法的首次着陆. 中间天数从源头一直持续到着陆,并离开上界. 当一个着陆拉力请求的作者在打开前将一个拉力请求合并到框架中时,一个着陆拉力请求算作之前的合并开启,每个拉力请求算作一次. 开放天数从打开到合并。 提案是表9的编码问题和抽取请求,过期的提案因不活动或清理问题而结案。 被否决的建议包括被重新定位到其他地方的建议。 ROLL在批量发布中发布代码,无需拉动请求.

blocks.en: The features above describe the methods that got in. The public records of the frameworks show how the others fared, and the main finding is an absence: maintainers turned away few methods, 12 of 1,561, because few were ever proposed. We downloaded all 26,960 issues, pull requests and discussions of the seven frameworks on 18 October 2026 (UTC) and searched them for every general method in the pool. A paper has a record when a thread links its arXiv page, gives its arXiv identifier or quotes its full title.
blocks.zh: 上面的特征描述了进入的方法. 这些框架的公开记录显示,其他框架的情况如何,主要的发现是缺失:维护者拒绝采用很少的方法,即1 561个框架中的12个,因为几乎没有人提出过。 我们于2026年10月18日下载了全部26,960个问题,拉动请求和对7个框架的讨论,并搜索了池内的每一个一般方法. 当一线程链接其arXiv页面,给出其arXiv标识符或引用其全标题时,纸张有记录.

blocks.en: Few methods appear in a framework’s public record. Most general methods that no framework included have no record in any of the seven frameworks, 1,500 of 1,561, and another 21 are cited only in passing, for example in lists of projects built on a framework. For 25 papers someone opened a pull request to implement the method, and for 15 more someone requested it in an issue or a discussion. Chat groups and internal repositories leave no public trace, so a missing record does not show that maintainers never saw a paper.
blocks.zh: 一个框架的公共记录中很少出现方法。 大多数没有列入框架的一般方法在7个框架中都没有记录,1 561个框架中有1 500个,另有21个只是顺便引用,例如,在一个框架基础上建立的项目清单。 对于25篇论文,有人提出了实施方法的拉动请求,对于另外15篇论文,有人在一个议题或讨论中提出了要求. 聊天组和内部寄存器没有留下公开的痕迹,因此缺失的记录没有显示维护者从未见过论文.

blocks.en: Method names were checked separately, because many are ambiguous. Among the 1,500 general methods without a record, 726 have a method name that occurs once in the pool, and 23 of these names appear in the threads. Reading those threads showed that 13 refer to the paper, 8 as proposals and 5 in passing. The other matches share a name with something else, such as the NCCL SHARP plugin. Counting the 13 lowers the share without a record from 96 to 95 percent, and applying the same rate to papers without a searchable name gives 94 percent. The coded proposals below come from link, identifier and title matches, so the 40 papers with a proposal are a lower bound: the name search found 8 more.
blocks.zh: 方法名称是分开检查的,因为许多名称含糊不清。 在没有记录的1500种一般方法中,726种方法名称一度出现在池中,其中23种名称出现在线程中. 阅读这些线索表明,13个文件提到该文件,8个是提案,5个是顺便提出的。 其他匹配则与其它东西共享一个名称,例如NCCL SHARP插件. 将13个没有记录的股份从96%降到95%, 对没有可搜索名称的报纸适用同样的比例, 则占94%。 下面的编码提案来自链接,标识符和标题匹配,因此带有提案的40篇论文是一个下限:名称搜索又发现了8篇.

blocks.en: Many proposals stay open without a reply. We coded each of the 48 threads on these 40 papers from its own text (Table 9 ). By the snapshot, 17 of the 28 pull requests were still open after a median of 196 days, and no prior merger had replied in 13 of them. Maintainers declined 4 pull requests and redirected 2, while the rest were withdrawn, closed as inactive or closed without a comment. Requests fared similarly: of the 20 in issues and discussions, a scheduled cleanup of inactive issues closed 8, and maintainers declined 4 and redirected 2. In 16 of the 17 open threads without a prior-merger reply, nobody except the proposer and automated reviewers had replied.
blocks.zh: 许多建议不作答复。 我们从自己的文本(表9)中将这40份文件上的48条线索逐一编码。 简讯显示,28项拉力请求中,有17项在中位数196天之后仍未解决,其中13项未答复先前的合并。 维护者拒绝了4次拉动请求,并重新定向了2次,而其余的则被撤回,作为不活动而关闭,或未经评论而关闭. 同样,在20个问题和讨论中,有计划清理闲置问题的工作结束8次,维护者减少4次,并重新定位 2. 国家 在17条未事先合并答复的开放线条中的16条中,除了提议者和自动审查员之外,没有人答复。

blocks.en: Merged pull requests drew concerns too. One reader coded the 88 merged landing pull requests and the 48 proposals with the same fields, each from the thread’s own text (Table 3 ). Someone other than the proposer raised a concern in 60 merged pull requests, mostly about design or missing tests and documentation. The proposer revised the code in 49 of the 88, and 41 still had an open concern when they were merged. Prior mergers raised the concerns in 57 of the 60 merged threads with a concern and in 17 of the 18 other threads with one.
blocks.zh: 合并拉动请求也引起关注。 一名读者对88项合并的着陆牵引请求和48项具有相同字段的提议进行编码,每个字段都来自线条本身的文本(表3). 提议者以外的人对60项合并拉力请求提出了关注,大多是设计或缺失测试和文件. 提议者在88年的49年修改了法典,41年合并时仍然有公开的关注. 以前的合并引起了60条合并线中的57条的关注,另外18条合并线中的17条引起了关注。

blocks.en: Table 3: Review records of merged pull requests and of proposals that were not merged. Unit: thread. Merged pull requests are the landing pull requests of recent methods, counted once each. Unmerged pull requests and requests are the proposals of Table 9 . A concern is a problem that someone other than the proposer raises explicitly, and one thread can carry several.
blocks.zh: 表3:审查合并拉票请求和未合并提案的记录。 单位:线程. 合并拉力请求是近代方法的着陆拉力请求,每次计算一次. 未合并的拉动请求和要求是表9的提议。 一个关切是提议者以外的人明确提出的问题,一个线条可以携带几个线条.

blocks.en: Concerns about demand and maintenance burden follow a different pattern: they appear in 6 of 88 merged pull requests, against 5 of 28 unmerged pull requests and 6 of 20 requests. All of these unmerged pull requests come from TRL, so this pattern describes TRL more than the whole ecosystem. Training results appear about as often in merged and unmerged pull requests, at 26 of 88 and 9 of 28. The largest difference is attention: 14 of the 28 unmerged pull requests drew no reply from anyone but the proposer, against 17 of the 88 merged ones. TRL weighs demand by the number of requests and reactions, and in one thread by whether other frameworks implement the method. slime keeps its main repository for changes that CI or routine training runs can verify, and it points other methods to separate repositories with reproducible recipes.
blocks.zh: 对需求和维持负担的关切有不同的模式:88项合并拉力请求中有6项出现,28项未合并拉力请求中有5项出现,20项请求中有6项出现。 所有这些未合并的牵引请求都来自TRL,因此这个模式比整个生态系统更能描述TRL. 培训结果往往出现在合并和未合并的牵引请求中,88份中有26份,28份中有9份。 最大的区别在于注意:在28项未合并的拉动请求中,有14项没有引起任何人的答复,只有提议者作出答复,而88项合并请求中有17项没有引起答复。 TRL通过请求和反应的数量来权衡需求,在一条线索中则通过其他框架是否实施方法来权衡需求. 粘液保持其主要存储器,用于CI或常规训练运行可以验证的更改,并指向其他方法,将存储器分离出可复制的食谱.

blocks.en: The frameworks handle proposals in different ways (Table 2 ). In TRL, prior mergers opened 13 of the 23 pull requests that brought methods in, and the project declined or redirected 10 of 18 proposals for other methods. verl takes methods in from other contributors, often as recipes: prior mergers opened 1 of its 27 landing pull requests, while 12 of 20 proposals for other methods remain open and 7 lapsed. slime and OpenRLHF add methods mainly through prior mergers, at 6 of 7 and 4 of 5 landing pull requests. NeMo-RL reviewers asked for training results in 8 of its 13 merged pull requests.
blocks.zh: 这些框架以不同方式处理建议(表2)。 在TRL中,先前的合并开启了23项拉动请求中的13项,引入了方法,项目拒绝了18项其他方法提案中的10项或重新定向。 verl从其他贡献者那里获取方法,常常作为配方:先前的合并开启了27项着陆拉动请求中的1项,而其他方法的20项提案中有12项仍未解决,7项失效。 粘液和OpenRLHF主要通过之前的兼并来添加方法,分别是7个和5个着陆拉力请求中的6个和4个. NeMo-RL审查员要求在其13项合并拉力请求中取得8项培训结果。

blocks.en: Some pull requests brought in several methods, so the 94 landings of recent methods with a pull request came from 88 distinct pull requests. Paper authors made a commit in 21 of the landings, and 22 followed an earlier request in the same repository. Counting each pull request once, prior mergers opened 29 of the 88. Merged pull requests had been open for a median of 6.5 days, a figure that covers only proposals that were merged. Inside each framework’s own package they changed a median of 117 lines, against 162 for proposals that were not merged. The form of the change coded from the paper relates only weakly to this size: medians are 88 lines for coefficient changes, 80 for new terms and 141 for pipeline changes, with each pull request counted once per form it carries.
blocks.zh: 一些拉力请求带来了几种方法,所以最近用拉力请求的94次着陆来自88次不同的拉力请求. 论文作者在其中21次登陆中做出了承诺,22次是在此前同一存放处提出请求后做出的。 计算每个拉动请求一次,之前的合并打开了88个中的29个. 合并拉动请求的中位数为6.5天,这一数字只涵盖合并后的提案。 在每一个框架的一揽子方案内,他们修改了117行的中位数,而没有合并的提案则修改了162行。 从纸张中编码的改变形式与这个大小只有微弱的关系:中位数是系数变化的88行,新术语为80行,管道变化为141行,每个拉动请求每次随附的形式计算一次.

blocks.en: Inclusion rarely reverses: 4 of the 114 landings of recent methods were later removed. TRL dropped the experimental trainers for GFPO, DPPO and PAPO, and AReaL dropped the AEnt recipe in a refactor. NeMo-RL reverted its first GSPO commit a day after it landed and added the method again with test fixes four days later.
blocks.zh: 包容很少反向 : 最近方法的114次着陆中有4次后来被移除. TRL放弃了GFPO,DPPO和PAPO的实验训练员,AReaL放弃了AEnt配方的重构. NeMo-RL恢复了其第一个普惠制O在登陆一天后的承诺,并在四天后再次添加了测试修正的方法。

blocks.en: One method arrived as a fix. In June 2025 a NeMo-RL developer implemented the KL gradient correction of Tang and Munos [69] behind a switch and withdrew it, because the experiments showed no gain. A year later a fix to the KL backward pass made the corrected gradient the behaviour of every run with a KL penalty, and its code cites the paper. We count this fix as the method’s landing, as a conditional default.
blocks.zh: 一种方法作为固定到达。 2025年6月,NeMo-RL开发者在开关后实施了Tang和Munos的KL梯度校正[69],并撤销了它,因为实验显示没有收获. 一年后,KL落后通道的修补使得每一次运行的行为都有KL惩罚,其代码引用了论文. 我们把这个固定点算作方法的落地,

blocks.en: 8 Failures that users report
blocks.zh: 8 用户报告的失败

blocks.en: The frameworks’ issues are where users would report the failures that the catalog’s methods address, so they record what users name in public. We screened the 7,075 issues and discussions opened in the seven frameworks between January 2025 and the snapshot with keyword patterns for the thirteen failures of the catalog, and one reader coded the title and opening post of each of the 648 matches (Appendix E ). A thread counts when its opener reports observing the failure in a run. Most matches were bugs, usage questions or feature requests, and 48 threads report a training failure (Table 4 ). Among them, 23 describe a collapse or divergence with no cause named, such as a loss that turns to NaN or a reward that drops to zero, and 12 name the mismatch between rollout and training probabilities. A random sample of 250 unscreened threads, read the same way, contained no failure report.
blocks.zh: 这些框架的问题在于用户将报告目录方法所处理的故障, 我们筛选了在2025年1月和快照之间七个框架开始的7 075个问题和讨论,并用关键词图案对目录的13个故障进行了描述,还有一位读者为648个匹配中的每一个的题目和开篇进行了编码(附录E)。 一个线程在打开器报告在运行中观测失败时计数 。 大多数匹配是错误,使用问题或特性请求,48个线程报告训练失败(表4). 其中,23描述了一个没有命名原因的坍塌或分歧,如转至NaN的损失或降为零的奖励,还有12个将推出与训练概率之间的不匹配命名. 随机抽查250条未筛选的线条,读法相同,无故障报告.

blocks.en: Table 4: Training failures in the frameworks’ issues against the methods that address them. Unit: thread in the first column, general method in the next two, catalog method in the last. Issue threads are issues and discussions opened since January 2025 with an opening post that reports the failure. General methods naming the failure are the pool’s general methods with an abstract that names it, with the number of those that at least one framework includes. Catalog methods are those addressing the failure that at least one framework includes. The two rows with dashes are failures outside the catalog’s list.
blocks.zh: 表4:对照解决这些问题的方法,框架问题的培训失败。 单位:第一列的线程,第二列的通用方法,最后一列的目录方法. 问题线索是2025年1月起开启的问题和讨论,并有一个公开的帖子报告失败. 命名失败的一般方法是集合的一般方法,它有一个抽象的命名方法,其中至少有一个框架包含的数目。 分类法是处理至少一个框架包括的故障的方法。 两行带有破折号,

blocks.en: The failures named in public differ from those that papers address. The failures that abstracts address most often, sparse reward in 218 general methods and the loss of diversity in 156, appear in no screened thread. The mismatch between rollout and training probabilities is named by 12 threads, and 20 general methods and 8 catalog methods in the frameworks address it, more than for any other failure. The record measures what users name in public and not what they need, because an abstract and an issue serve different purposes and the 23 collapses with no cause named may belong to any row of the table. Requests for methods outnumber failure reports: 59 threads ask for one, 8 of them for DAPO’s dynamic sampling, 6 for TIS or MIS and 4 for rollout routing replay, all methods that several frameworks already include. TRL weighs demand by such requests (Section 7 ), and these counts show how thin that signal is: the most requested method drew 8 requests across seven frameworks in 21 months. The random sample of 250 unscreened threads supports the screen and no more, so the counts are lower bounds, and a count of zero shows that nobody named the failure and not that nobody met it.
blocks.zh: 公开点名的失败与报纸上提到的失败不同。 在218种一般方法中,失败往往涉及微薄的奖励,在156种方法中则涉及多样性的丧失,但无筛选线索。 推出和培训概率的不匹配用12个线程命名,框架中的20个一般方法和8个目录方法解决,比其他任何故障都要多. 记录衡量了用户在公共场合的称谓,而不是他们需要的称谓,因为一个抽象和一个问题服务于不同的目的,23个无命名原因的崩溃可能属于表的任何一行. 对方法的要求超过了失败报告:59条线索要求1条,其中8条用于DAPO的动态取样,6条用于TIS或MIS,4条用于推出路径重播,这些方法已经包括几个框架。 TRL通过这种请求来权衡需求(第7节),这些计数表明这一信号有多细:最需要的方法是在21个月内从七个框架中抽取了8项请求。 250条未筛选线程的随机样本支持屏幕,不再使用,因此计数是下限,一个零的计数显示没有人给故障命名,而不是没有人遇到.

blocks.en: 9 Methods in large model reports
blocks.zh: 第9条 大型示范报告的方法

blocks.en: Inclusion describes framework code, so we read the technical reports of large open-weight models for the included methods their training used. The pool holds 13 reports of open-weight models with 100B parameters or more, from DeepSeek-R1 in January 2025 to Ling and Ring 2.6 in June 2026 (Table 5 ). The pool requires reinforcement learning in the title or abstract, so reports that mention RL only in the body fall outside it: Qwen3 [ 81 ] , the model behind GSPO, is one of them, and Appendix E lists the others we know of. For each report we read the RL sections and recorded the training algorithm, the framework it names and the widely included methods of Table 1 it states that it used. A method counts as stated when the report names it or cites its source, and a change described under another name counts as a variant.
blocks.zh: 包容描述了框架代码,所以我们阅读了大型开放量级模型的技术报告,说明它们所使用的培训方法。 池内保存有13份具有100B参数或以上的开放量模型报告,从2025年1月的DeepSeek-R1到2026年6月的Ling和Ring 2.6(表5). 池子需要在标题或抽象中进行强化学习,因此仅在身体中提及RL的报告就属于其外层: Quen3 [81],普惠制O背后的模型就是其中之一,附录E列出了我们所知的其他. 对于每份报告,我们读取RL部分,并记录培训算法、它所命名的框架以及它所使用的表1广泛包含的方法。 一种方法在报告命名或引用其来源时算得上,另一种名称下描述的更改则算作变体。

blocks.en: Table 5: Widely included methods stated by technical reports of open-weight models with 100B parameters or more. Unit: report in the pool. A check marks a method the report states it used, S marks the report that is the method’s source, V a variant described under another name, and T a method tried and not kept. Framework stated is the training system the report names.
blocks.zh: 表5:广泛包括有100B参数或以上的开放重量模型的技术报告中所述的方法。 单位:报入池. 检查标记了报告所说的一种方法,S标记了作为方法来源的报告,V标记了以另一种名称描述的变体,T标记了一种尝试了而没有保存的方法。 所述框架是报告名称的培训系统。

blocks.en: The reports name the included methods, but each names few. Of the 13 reports, 6 state at least one of the 13 methods, 2 are the source of one, and 3 describe a variant under their own name. DeepSeek’s Keep Routing replays the rollout’s expert routes as rollout routing replay does, LongCat filters all-correct and all-wrong prompts with replacement where DAPO samples without, and KPop replaces IcePop’s ratio bounds with a binary KL test. Token-level loss aggregation is stated most often, by 3 reports. The KL term is removed in 4 reports, a change every framework allows through its KL coefficient and TRL made the default. None of the methods appears in 4 reports: DeepSeek-R1 and Llama-Nemotron predate most of them, Kimi K2 keeps the K1.5 objective, and gpt-oss gives no detail. No report states SAPO, GDPO or REINFORCE++, rollout routing replay appears only as a variant, and TIS appears only as a comparison. One of the seven frameworks is named in 4 reports: GLM-4.5 trains on slime, Ring-1T and Ling and Ring 2.6 on AReaL, and Nemotron 3 Ultra on NeMo-RL. Llama-Nemotron names NeMo-Aligner, the predecessor of NeMo-RL, and the other reports train on in-house systems. The reports are a second observable record of practice, and it overlaps with the frameworks’ code: the stabilisers that six or seven frameworks ship are the ones the reports state. The overlap does not show the order of influence, because we read the latest version of each report, and the frameworks took in GSPO and MIS within weeks of the papers that introduced them.
blocks.zh: 报告列出包括的方法,但每个方法都很少。 在13份报告中,6份至少说明13种方法中的一种,2份是1种方法的来源,3份是用自己的名字描述一种变体。 DeepSeek的Routing在推出路线重放时重放推出的专家路线,LongCat过滤所有正确和完全错误的提示,在DAPO样本没有的地方替换,KPop用二进制KL测试取代IcePop的极限比例. 3份报告中最经常地说明了数据级损失汇总。 KL术语在4份报告中被删除,每个框架通过KL系数允许的改变,TRL做了默认. 4份报告中没有任何方法: DeepSeek-R1和Llama-Nemotron在它们大多数之前,Kimi K2保持了K1.5的目标,gpt-os没有给出细节. 没有报告说明SAPO,GDPO或REINFORCE++,推出的路由重播只作为变体出现,TIS只作为比较出现. 7个框架之一在4份报告中被命名:粘液上的GLM-4.5列车,AReaL上的Ring-1T和Ling及Ring 2.6列车,Nemotron 3 Ultra上的NeMo-RL. Llama-Nemotron命名为NeMo-Aligner,NeMo-RL的前身,其他报告列车在内部系统中. 这些报告是第二个可观察到的实践记录,它与框架的规范重叠:六七框架船是报告所说的稳定者。 重叠并不显示影响力的先后次序,因为我们阅读了每份报告的最新版本,而且在介绍这些报告的文件提出后数周内,框架采用了普惠制组织和管理信息系统。

blocks.en: 10 Implications for researchers and maintainers
blocks.zh: 10 对研究人员和维护者的影响

blocks.en: The comparison and the record describe past inclusion, and each paragraph below pairs a property of included methods with one step that a paper and its authors can take. None of these steps is shown to raise the chance of inclusion.
blocks.zh: 比较和记录描述了过去的列入情况,下面的每个段落将包含方法的属性与论文及其作者可以采取的一步相配. 这些步骤都没有显示能增加包容的机会。

blocks.en: Most methods never enter a framework’s public record, while 22 of the 94 landings followed an earlier issue or discussion that cited the paper. A record does not secure attention, since verl closed 7 of its 20 proposals for other methods in scheduled cleanups. A short issue that names the training failure, the change and the evidence still gives maintainers something to find and answer.
blocks.zh: 大多数方法从未进入一个框架的公开记录,而94次着陆中有22次遵循了先前引用该文件的问题或讨论。 记录没有引起注意,因为verl在排定的清理中完成了20项关于其他方法的建议中的7项。 一个将训练失败,改变和证据命名的短篇问题,仍然给维护者一些发现和答案.

blocks.en: Each framework states its own rules. TRL asks for tests, documentation and an entry in its paper index, and it adds options to its main trainer only with visible demand. slime accepts changes that routine runs can verify, and verl collects many methods as recipes. General libraries can set stricter thresholds: the rule of thumb of scikit-learn for a new algorithm is three years since publication, 200 citations and wide use [ 60 ] . The RL frameworks took methods in within a median of 30 days, so their written rules and their review do the selecting. Merged pull requests drew concerns about design and tests in most cases, and their proposers often revised the code. A proposal that follows the written rules answers part of these concerns in advance.
blocks.zh: 每个框架都规定了自己的规则。 TRL要求测试,文档及其纸质索引中的条目,它只在有明显需求的情况下为其主教练添加选项. 粘液接受常规运行可以验证的改变,verl收集了许多方法作为食谱. 一般库可以设置更严格的阈值:用于新算法的scikit-learn的拇指规则是自发布以来的三年,200引用和广泛使用[60]. RL框架在30天的中位数内采纳了方法,因此其书面规则和审查是选择的。 合并拉动请求在多数情况下引起了对设计和测试的担忧,其提议者经常修改代码. 一项遵循书面规则的建议事先回答了其中一部分关切。

blocks.en: Training results in the thread did not separate merged from unmerged pull requests, but NeMo-RL reviewers asked for them in 8 of 13 merged pull requests, and TRL asked for reproduced results before adding a method to its main trainer. A configuration, a seed and a short run on a public model let maintainers check that the method runs and shows its signal. Matching the paper’s gains takes its baselines, data and budget.
blocks.zh: 线程中的培训结果并没有与未合并的拉力请求分开,但NeMo-RL审查员在13个合并拉力请求中的8个请求了这些结果,TRL在给其主要教练员添加一个方法之前要求复制结果. 一个配置,一个种子和一个公共模型上的短跑让维护者检查方法运行并显示其信号. 与论文的成果相匹配需要其基线、数据和预算。

blocks.en: Included papers more often named an observed training failure, at 84 against 70 percent. Reporting the signal of that failure, such as the entropy curve or the divergence between rollout and training probabilities, lets others check the fix on their own runs.
blocks.zh: 包括的文件更经常地将所观察到的培训失败命名为84%对70%。 报告这种故障的信号,如 en曲线或推出与训练概率的差异,让其他人自行检查固定运行.

blocks.en: Included papers more often trained policies of 30B parameters or more. Teams without that compute can still target failures that larger runs report and publish the signal above, so that groups with more compute can test the fix.
blocks.zh: 更经常地包括经过培训的30B参数政策。 没有计算结果的团队仍然可以瞄准更大的运行报告并发布上面的信号的故障,这样计算结果较多的团队就可以测试固定值.

blocks.en: Included papers more often changed a coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss, and frameworks expose these methods as one or two configuration fields. A paper can name the configuration field it changes, the training stage it touches and any models it needs, so that maintainers can place the change without reading the code.
blocks.zh: 列入的文件更经常地改变现有损失中的系数、夹片、遮罩或重量,框架将这些方法暴露为一两个配置字段。 纸张可以命名它改变的配置字段,它触及的训练舞台和它需要的任何模型,这样维护者就可以在不读代码的情况下放置变化.

blocks.en: Frameworks included 10 of 187 general methods on clipping, off-policy correction and loss aggregation, and 4 of 554 on rollout sampling and credit assignment. Methods in the second group can also live in user code, outside the options we track. In the frameworks’ issues, the mismatch between rollout and training probabilities was named in 12 failure reports and 6 method requests, while no screened thread named sparse reward or the loss of diversity (Section 8 ).
blocks.zh: 框架包括关于剪报、政策外更正和损失汇总的187种一般方法中的10种,关于推出抽样和信贷分配的554种方法中的4种。 第二组中的方法也可以生活在用户代码中,在我们追踪的选项之外. 在框架问题上,12份失败报告和6项方法请求都提到推出和培训概率之间的不匹配,而没有任何筛选线索被命名为稀缺的奖励或多样性的丧失(第8节)。

blocks.en: The record also shows what a framework could change, under the same caveat. Proposals go unanswered more often than they are refused: 13 of the 17 open pull requests for other methods had no reply from a prior merger after a median of 196 days. Scheduled cleanups closed 8 of 20 requests and 7 of 20 proposals in verl. A stated route for methods, such as verl’s recipes or slime’s separate repositories, lets a maintainer answer a proposal with a destination instead of leaving it to the cleanup. A proposal template that asks for the failure, the change, the evidence and the configuration field would put in the first message the items that reviewers raised in 60 of 88 merged pull requests. Demand measured by requests is thin (Section 8 ), so a framework that waits for requests before adding an option will see few. The technical reports of large runs (Section 9 ) name the failures those runs met and the methods they used, a second public record a framework can read.
blocks.zh: 记录还表明,在同样的告诫下,一个框架可以改变什么。 在17项关于其他方法的公开拉票请求中,13项在196天的中位数之后没有得到先前合并的答复。 排定的清理工作结束了20项请求中的8项和20项提案中的7项。 由维护者用目的地回答提案, 在88项合并拉力请求中,有60项请求中,有一份提案模板要求失败、更改、证据和配置字段。 以请求来衡量的需求是有限的(第8节),因此,在增加一个选项之前等待请求的框架将很少。 大型跑步的技术报告(第9节)列出了那些跑步失败者及其使用的方法,这是第二个可以阅读的公开记录。

blocks.en: 11 Limitations
blocks.zh: 11 限制

blocks.en: Inclusion is not use: we observe implementations on main branches, and the data do not show the frequency of use or the results users get. Section 9 reads what 13 reports state, and a statement in a report is not code either. The numerator is a lower bound, because it counts only options we can parse and implementations that framework files cite. Sampling and reward logic can live outside framework options, so the component comparison covers framework options only. The pool is screened from three arXiv categories, and the seven frameworks represent neither closed training stacks nor every open one. Four other open frameworks meet the selection criteria, and their current code adds 2 general methods to the included set (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 包容不使用:我们在主要分支上观察执行,数据没有显示使用频率或用户得到的结果. 第9节说明了13份报告所述的情况,报告中的说明也不是编码。 数字是一个下限,因为它只计算我们能分析的选项和框架文件引用的实现. 抽样和奖励逻辑可以活在框架选项之外,因此组件比较只涵盖框架选项. 人才库从三个arXiv类别中筛选出来,七个框架既不是封闭的训练堆,也不是每一个开放的。 另有四个开放式框架符合选择标准,其目前的代码在包含的一套中增加了两种一般方法(第3节)。

blocks.en: The comparison in Section 6 is observational and small. Affiliations come from each paper’s first page and match a framework at the level of the company, so a team that works with a framework’s maintainers from another company counts as outside. The public record misses chat groups and internal repositories, and the search by method name reaches only names that are distinctive. ROLL and AReaL publish much of their code in bulk releases. Landings without a pull request still went through review, and the pull requests with a record do not represent each framework’s whole process. Thread texts can be edited or deleted after the fact, and one reader coded the review fields of all threads. The failure reading of Section 8 covers titles and opening posts after a keyword screen, by one reader, so its counts are lower bounds, and a collapse reported without a cause may belong to any of the failures. The reports of Section 9 cover 13 models from nine organisations and state what their authors chose to write. Whether maintainers act on such reports, on requests or on their own runs is not measured here, so the overlap between the reports and the frameworks’ code is an observation and not a direction of influence.
blocks.zh: 第6节中的比较是观察性的和小的。 联系来自每份文件的第一页,与公司一级的框架相匹配,因此与另一个公司的框架维护者合作的团队算作外部。 公共记录错过了聊天组和内部寄存器,按方法搜索的名称只触及有特色的名称. ROLL和AReaL在批量发布中公布了他们的大部分代码. 没有拉动请求的着陆仍然经过审查,有记录的拉动请求并不代表每个框架的整个过程. 线程文本可以在事后编辑或删除,一个读者编码了所有线程的评论字段. 第8节的失败阅读涵盖了关键字屏幕后的标题和打开帖子,由一位读者,因此其计数是较低的,无缘无故报告的崩溃可能属于任何失败. 第9节的报告涵盖了9个组织的13个模式,并说明了作者选择写什么。 维护者是对这类报告采取行动,还是提出要求,还是自行采取行动,在此不加以衡量,因此报告与框架守则之间的重叠是一个观察,而不是影响的方向。

blocks.en: 12 The tracker
blocks.zh: 第12条 追踪器

blocks.en: The data and code behind this report form a maintained tracker at https://github.com/pth2002/rl-method-tracker . Its index groups the catalog by the training failure each method addresses. For every method it shows the frameworks that include it, the tier and the day it landed, with the setting that selects the method and a link to the file and line at the analysed commit. A second page gives, for each framework, its contribution rules, the files that hold its algorithms, the pull requests that brought recent methods in, the concerns raised in their review and the outcome of earlier proposals. Readers can report a wrong record through a correction form in the repository. A weekly job pulls the frameworks, re-traces their history, verifies sources against arXiv and opens a pull request. An option the parser detects without a mapping fails validation, so a person reviews every addition before it reaches the index. The release fixes the samples, labels, full-text coding and framework commits behind this report, together with a checksum list. It also stores the record of proposals. For each general method it lists the issues and pull requests that cite it, their state at the snapshot and the coded outcome. Thread texts stay on GitHub, and each coded thread keeps one short quote as evidence for its code. The release also stores the coded failure reports of Section 8 and the readings of the model reports of Section 9 , each with one quote. The weekly job also refreshes this record and lists new proposals for coding. A separate command checks the inputs against that list and reproduces the report’s numbers, tables and figures without network access.
blocks.zh: https://github.com/pth2002/rl-method-tracker上的数据和代码构成一个维持的跟踪器。 它的索引通过每个方法地址的训练失败来分组目录. 对于每一种方法,它都显示包含它的框架,阶梯和着陆日,其中设置了选择方法的设置,并在分析承诺时与文件和行链接. 第二页介绍了每个框架的贡献规则、持有其算法的文件、采用最新方法的拉动请求、审查中提出的关切以及先前提案的结果。 读者可以通过寄存器中的更正表报告错误的记录. 每周一次的工作拉动框架,重新追踪其历史,验证源对arXiv,并开启拉动请求. 解析器在没有映射失败验证的情况下检测到的选项,所以在到达索引之前,一个人会审查每一个添加. 发布会修复本报告后面的样本、标签、全文编码和框架,以及核对和清单。 它还存储了提案的记录。 对于每一种一般方法,它都列出问题并拉动引用它的请求,它们在快照时的状态和编码的结果. 线索文本保留在GitHub上,每个编码线程都保留一个简短的引号作为它代码的证据. 该版还存储了第8节的编码故障报告以及第9节的模型报告的读数,每个版本都有一个引文. 每周的工作也刷新了这个记录,并列出新的编码建议. 一个单独的指令对照该清单检查投入,并转载报告的数字、表格和数字,而无网络访问。

blocks.en: 13 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 13. 结论

blocks.en: Most RL methods for language models reach practitioners as papers and not as options in the frameworks they train with. Between January 2025 and June 2026, 2.3 percent of the general RL training methods in our pool reached one of seven open-source frameworks, and three or more frameworks include 7 of 1,598 today. Across five quarterly cohorts the papers grew 5.4-fold while those included within 180 days stayed at 5 to 7. Included methods more often changed one part of the existing loss and more often came with experiments on large policies, while released code was as common among them as among the others. Merged pull requests drew concerns about design and tests as well, while concerns about demand and maintenance burden appeared mostly in proposals that were not merged. Yet few methods were turned away in public, because most never reached a framework’s issues or pull requests at all. Users rarely report training failures in those issues, and the technical reports of large open-weight models state the methods that most frameworks include, so the public record of demand is thin and the record of practice at scale overlaps with the frameworks’ code. Other fields with shared training or evaluation code can reuse this measurement, since it needs only paper versions, implementation histories and public proposals. The tracker lists where each framework keeps its algorithms, the concerns its reviewers raised and the outcome of earlier proposals, so that authors can bring a method that far.
blocks.zh: 多数语言模型的RL方法作为论文送达从业者,而不是作为他们培训的框架的选项. 从2025年1月至2026年6月,我们人才库中2.3%的一般RL培训方法达到7个开放源码框架之一,3个或更多框架包括7个,即今天的1 598个。 五个季度的论文增长了5.4倍,而180天内的论文则保持在5-7天。 包括的方法更经常地改变了现有损失的一部分,而且更经常的是对大保单进行实验,而公布的代码与其他方法一样常见。 合并的拉力请求也引起了对设计和测试的关切,而对需求和维修负担的关切大多出现在没有合并的提案中。 然而,很少有方法在公开场合被放弃,因为大多数方法从未触及到框架的问题,或完全没有提出过要求。 用户很少报告在这些问题上的培训失败,大型开放量模型的技术报告说明了大多数框架包括的方法,因此公开的需求记录很少,规模上的做法记录与框架的代码重叠。 具有共同培训或评价代码的其他领域可以重新使用这一计量方法,因为它只需要纸张版本、执行历史和公众建议。 追踪器列出了每个框架保存其算法的地方、审查者提出的关切以及先前提案的结果,以便作者能够提出一个方法。

blocks.en: The comparison covers every included general method from 2025 and a random sample of general methods from 2025 that no framework included. Controls were drawn within each quarter, in proportion to the quarterly counts of included papers at sampling time. The quarterly counts are 7, 10, 7 and 7 for included papers and 32, 54, 27 and 37 for controls. Papers were coded in a shuffled order without access to inclusion status, and every field was read from the first arXiv version. The included papers found by the citation audit were coded later from their first versions. A second reader recoded all of them blind, together with 16 controls, and the comparison uses the blind codes. On the recoded controls the two readers agree on size thresholds, mixture of experts, extra models, compute and affiliation, and differ most on code release and failure motivation. With the recoded controls substituted, the two main gaps compare against 14 of 141 and 12 of 149 controls. arXiv withdrew the first version of 1 control paper, and the comparison leaves it out. Each paper was coded on the following fields. • Affiliations on the first page, and whether the version links training code for the method. • Whether the method trained a policy of at least 14B and of at least 30B parameters, and whether it trained a mixture of experts. • The form of the change. A coefficient change alters a coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss. A term adds a loss term, estimator or sampling rule. A pipeline change adds a training stage, a model or a system component. • The number of new hyperparameters, and whether the method needs an extra model. • Whether the paper is motivated by an observed training failure. • The evaluation domains, and whether compute is reported. Fields a paper does not state were left empty and are excluded from the corresponding row of Figure 3 . Papers without an empirical evaluation are excluded from the row on evaluation breadth.

blocks.en: Appendix E The public record

blocks.en: The record covers 26,960 issues, pull requests and discussions downloaded through the GitHub API on 18 October 2026 (UTC), after the framework snapshots in Table 10 . Every discussion was read in full, and none had more comments than one request returns. Formal review texts were read for the coded threads and the landing pull requests only. A thread matches a paper through a link to its arXiv, Hugging Face papers or alphaXiv page, its identifier after “arXiv:”, its bare identifier, or its full title of at least five words. Identifiers are checked against the pool, so every match names a pool paper. The separate search by method name uses names of at least four characters with a capital letter that occur once in the pool, and every match for a paper without a record was read in its thread.
blocks.zh: 该记录涵盖26,960期,拉动请求和讨论,在表10的框架快照之后,于2026年10月18日通过GitHub API(UTC)下载. 每次讨论都全文宣读,除了一个请求的回复之外,没有任何评论。 为编码线程和着陆牵引请求阅读了正式审查文本。 线程通过链接到它的arXiv,huging Face papers或alphaXiv页面,其标识符在“arXiv:”之后,其赤裸的标识符,或至少5个单词的全称来匹配纸张. 识别器与游泳池对照检查,所以每个匹配者都命名为游泳池纸. 按方法命名的单独搜索使用至少4个字符的名字,其中大写字母一次出现在池中,每对没有记录的纸张的匹配都在其线程中读取.

blocks.en: The citation audit reads every line added on each main branch and keeps the first commit that cites a paper in each file. All files citing a paper were checked by hand. Of the 23 general methods cited in framework files but missed by parsing, 9 sit next to an implementation, including the NeMo-RL fix to the KL gradient and ROLL’s trajectory-level agent pipeline. Another 10 appear in lists of projects or news, 2 in reference lists of technical report PDFs read as text, and 2 as a configuration note or a background reference.
blocks.zh: 引用审计阅读了每个主要分支上添加的每行内容,并保留每个文件中引用一纸文件的第一个承诺. 引用一份文件的所有文件都经过手工检查。 在框架文件引用但因解析而错过的23种一般方法中,有9种坐在一个执行的旁边,包括NeMo-RL对KL梯度的固定和ROLL的轨迹级代理管道。 另外10个出现在项目或新闻列表中,2个出现在技术报告参考列表中,PDF读作文本,2个作为配置说明或背景参考.

blocks.en: Each proposal thread received one outcome and the reasons a maintainer stated explicitly in it, coded from the thread’s own text. A first reader coded all threads, and a second reader coded them again blind to the first coding. The analysis uses the blind codes. The two codings agree on the outcome of 40 of 48 threads as raw agreement, and most differences concern redirects and withdrawals. Outcomes follow a fixed order. A proposer who closes the thread has withdrawn it. A maintainer who sends the proposal to an example, an experimental folder or a separate repository has redirected it. An explicit refusal is a decline, and a closure by a scheduled rule is a stale cleanup. When several threads in one framework concern the same paper, such as a withdrawn first attempt and its replacement, we code the main thread. Demand covers the number of requests, reactions and implementations elsewhere. Maintenance burden covers new options, trainers or interfaces to keep. Placement covers a move to an experimental folder, a recipe, an example or a separate repository. Evidence covers results to reproduce or gains to show. The other reasons are missing tests or documentation, an objection to the interface or architecture of the change, and an existing feature that already covers the case. A stated reason is also a concern in the review fields of the same thread, and one adjudication resolved the two threads where the codings first disagreed. The review fields of Table 3 were coded for every merged landing pull request and every proposal with one set of rules. A concern counts when someone other than the proposer raises it explicitly, and requests about style or naming do not count. An open concern is one the thread leaves unaddressed at its end, including follow-up work named at the merge.
blocks.zh: 每个提案线索都收到一个结果,一个维护者在其中明确说明了从线索本身文本中编码出来的原因。 第一位读者对所有线程进行编码,第二位读者再次对第一次编码视而不见. 分析采用盲码. 两种编码都同意48条线中的40条线作为原始协议的结果,大多数分歧涉及重定向和撤回. 结果遵循固定顺序。 索线关闭的求婚者已撤回. 向实例,实验文件夹或单独的寄存器发送建议书的维护者已经将其重定向. 明确拒绝就是减少,按预定规则结束就是彻底清理。 当一个框架中的几个线程涉及同一个纸,例如撤回的第一次尝试及其替换时,我们编码主线程. 需求包括请求、反应和执行到其他地方的次数。 维护负担包括新选项、培训人员或需要保存的接口。 放置覆盖移动到实验文件夹,食谱,实例或单独的寄存器. 证据包括复制结果或展示收益。 其他原因包括缺少测试或文档,对更改的界面或架构的反对,以及已经覆盖了案件的现有特性. 同一线索的审查领域也关切一个已说明的理由,一项裁决解决了编码最初不一致的两个线索。 表3的审查领域对每次合并的着陆牵引请求和每份提案都有一套规则进行编码。 一个关切在提议者以外的人明确提出时算数,关于风格或命名的要求不算数. 一个公开关切的问题是,这条线索在结尾处没有解决,包括在合并时命名的后续工作。

blocks.en: The failure reading of Section 8 screened every issue and discussion opened since 1 January 2025 with keyword patterns for the thirteen failures of the catalog. The patterns were applied to the title and the first 800 characters of the opening post after removing code blocks, logs and configuration lines. One reader coded each of the 648 matches as a failure report with the failure named, a bug, a usage question, a feature request or other. A method request is a thread that asks for a named method. The recall sample draws 250 unscreened threads at random with a fixed seed, and the release keeps each coded thread’s number, title, keywords and code. The report reading of Section 9 takes every model report in the pool for an open-weight model with 100B or more total parameters, reads its RL sections in the latest arXiv version, and keeps one quote per report with the methods it states. Reports that mention RL only in the body are outside the pool. Among the open-weight models with 100B or more parameters released in the window, the reports of Qwen3 [ 81 ] , Pangu Ultra MoE [ 68 ] , Intern-S1 [ 3 ] , Command A [ 71 ] , dots.llm1 [ 30 ] and Step-3 [ 67 ] fall outside it. This list comes from our own check of the models we know and not from a systematic search.
blocks.zh: 第8节的失败阅读对2025年1月1日以来开始的每期和每期讨论都进行了筛选,对目录的13个失败进行了关键词模式分析。 这些图案在删除代码块,日志和配置行后,被应用于标题和开封帖的前800个字符. 1个读取器将648中每个读取器编码为故障报告,与命名的故障,错误,使用问题,特性请求或其他内容匹配. 方法请求是一个线程,它要求一个命名方法. 召回样本以固定种子随机抽取250条未筛选线程,发行时保留了每个编码线程的编号,标题,关键词和代码. 第9节的阅读报告将集合中的每个模型报告都用于一个有100B或更多总参数的开放量模型,在最新arXiv版本中读取其RL部分,每份报告保留一个引文,并采用它所述的方法。 仅在体内提到RL的报告不在池外. 在窗口中释放出100B或更多参数的开放量级模型中,Quen3 [81],Pangu Ultra MoE [68],Intern-S1 [3],Command A [71],dots.llm1 [30] 和Step-3 [67]的报告都发生在它之外. 这个清单来自我们自己对已知模型的检查,而不是系统的搜索.
